nodes.rationale: API posts cannot use Instagram's music library, so royalty-free music (e.g. Upbeat Summer, Pixabay) is baked in.

nodes.label: Descriptive Titles Instead of Hashtags
nodes.rationale: Old titles were hashtags or dates, so YouTube couldn't tell what videos were about.
